data.description: Practise building fractions visually using interactive circle slices to strengthen your understanding of parts and wholes.

judgement.reasoning: The generated detour merely asks the student to shade static individual fractions (1/2, 2/3, 2/4, 3/5, 6/8) on a circle. It involves no addition, no combining of parts, and does nothing to show why the denominator stays the same when fractions are added.
judgement.verdict: No teacher would use this detour because it completely omits addition and fails to address the misconception of adding denominators.
